title: Centreon Rust SNMP collection

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, so editors provide completion and inline documentation.

collect.title: Collection stage
collect.description: SNMP queries executed before any metric is computed.

snmp.description: Queries to run. All `Get` queries are batched into a single GetBulk request; each `Walk` query is a separate subtree traversal.

snmpQuery.title: SNMP query
snmpQuery.description: One SNMP query and the macro namespace under which its values are exposed to the compute stage.

name.description:
Macro name under which the collected value is exposed to expressions.

Without `labels`, the value is referenced as `{name}`: a scalar for a `Get` query, a vector (one entry per row) for a `Walk`.
With `labels`, one macro per label is created instead, named `{name.<label>}`.

oid.description:
OID to query, in numeric dotted form. A leading dot is accepted and ignored.

For a `Get` query this must be a leaf OID (index included, usually ending in `.0`); for a `Walk` it is the root of the subtree to traverse.

query.description: Kind of SNMP operation. Values are case sensitive.

oneOf.title: Retrieve a single leaf OID value.
Traverse the subtree under `oid` with repeated GetBulk requests.

labels.description:
Splits a `Walk` over a table into one named macro per column. Only meaningful with `"query": "Walk"`.

Each key is the column part of the OID — the walked OID minus its trailing row index — matched as a suffix, so both `".2"` and `"2"` select column 2. Each value is the label appended to the query name, giving the macro `{<name>.<label>}`.

Example: walking `1.3.6.1.2.1.25.2.3.1` under the name `storage` with `{".3": "description", ".6": "used"}` yields the vectors `{storage.description}` and `{storage.used}`, aligned row by row.

additionalProperties.description: Label appended to the query name to build the macro name.

compute.title: Compute stage
compute.description: Metrics derived from the collected values.

metrics.description:
First-pass metrics, computed from the `collect` macros. May be empty when the check only reports aggregations or a plain status message.

Each metric is exposed to the aggregation pass as `{metrics.<name>}`.

aggregations.description:
Second-pass metrics, computed after `metrics` and able to reference them as `{metrics.<name>}` — typically to sum or average a per-instance metric into a global one.

The pass is skipped entirely when every instance has been discarded by `--filter-in` / `--filter-out`. Each aggregation is exposed as `{aggregations.<name>}`, usable in `output` templates.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: A value to compute, threshold and report as perfdata.

name.description:
Metric name, reported in the perfdata and used to reference the result as `{metrics.<name>}` or `{aggregations.<name>}`.

For a metric evaluating to a vector, the perfdata is named `'<instance>#<name>'`, the instance coming from `prefix`.

value.description:
Expression producing the metric value. A scalar expression yields one perfdata; a vector expression (a `Walk` macro, or an arithmetic combination of vectors) yields one perfdata per row.

Syntax: numbers, `+ - * /`, parentheses, macros in braces (`{storage.used}`), and the functions `Average(...)`, `Min(...)` and `Max(...)`, which reduce a vector macro to a scalar.

prefix.description:
Template naming each instance of a vector metric, interpolated with the collected macros — usually the label column of the walked table.

When omitted, instances are numbered from 0. The resulting name is what `--filter-in` and `--filter-out` match against.

The template is only interpolated for a metric evaluating to a vector; for a scalar metric, and for any aggregation, the string is used as-is.

uom.description: Unit of measurement appended to the perfdata value, as defined by the Monitoring Plugins guidelines. Empty by default (dimensionless).

min.description: Static lower bound reported in the perfdata. Ignored when `min_expr` is set.

min_expr.description: Expression computing the lower bound reported in the perfdata. Takes precedence over `min`.

max.description: Static upper bound reported in the perfdata. Ignored when `max_expr` is set.

max_expr.description: Expression computing the upper bound reported in the perfdata. Takes precedence over `max`.

threshold-suffix.description:
Exposes the metric on the command line as `--warning-<suffix>` and `--critical-<suffix>`; those options override the `warning` and `critical` fields below. Metrics without a suffix cannot be thresholded from the command line.

The suffixes of a collection are listed by `--list-counters`.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression over collected macros: numbers, `+ - * /`, parentheses, `{macro}` references and the `Average()`, `Min()`, `Max()` functions.

threshold.description:
Alert range in Monitoring Plugins threshold format (https://nagios-plugins.org/doc/guidelines.html#THRESHOLDFORMAT):

- `end` — alert if value > end (equivalent to `0:end`)
- `start:` — alert if value < start
- `~:end` — alert if value > end, no lower bound
- `start:end` — alert if value is outside the range
- `@start:end` — inverted: alert if value is inside the range

output.title: Output stage
output.description:
Status messages and separators used to render the plugin output. The whole object is optional; every field falls back to its default.

Messages are templates: `{metrics.<name>}` and `{aggregations.<name>}` are replaced by the computed values.

ok.description: Message reported when every metric is within its thresholds.

detail_ok.description: Append the per-instance detail of the metrics to the OK message.

warning.description: Prefix of the message reported when the worst status is WARNING.

detail_warning.description: Append the detail of the metrics in alert to the WARNING message.

critical.description: Prefix of the message reported when the worst status is CRITICAL.

detail_critical.description: Append the detail of the metrics in alert to the CRITICAL message.

unknown.description: Prefix of the message reported when the worst status is UNKNOWN.

detail_unknown.description: Append the detail of the metrics in alert to the UNKNOWN message.

no_data.description: Message reported when no metric is left once `--filter-in` / `--filter-out` have been applied. The status name given by `--no-data-status` is prepended to it.

instance_separator.description: String inserted between two instances in the detail message.

metric_separator.description: String inserted between two metrics of the same instance in the detail message.
